instrument: the r110 D3 design (eval/r110_d3_instrument_prereg.json) re-executed FRESH end-to-end — no r110 generation bytes are reused; every arm regenerates from a fresh stage-A fetch
corpus: eval/r106_score9_corpus_postcutoff/sampled_items.jsonl (the committed post-cutoff corpus, 30 items, the same source as r110 stage A)

stages.A_refetch: Crossref works API query BY TITLE (read-only, polite pool, zero quota), per-item DOI/abstract(JATS-stripped)/publisher/date + the title-match score; match < 0.8 normalized token-overlap types the item OUT (fail-closed); output eval/r113_engine_bare_corpus/fetched_abstracts.jsonl
stages.B_author: agnes-3.0-flash (NOT a judge family), ONE call per item from the FETCHED abstract (+ ONE repair retry on strict-JSON parse failure, the r110 pattern); schema: background_question, background_survey, inspiration_papers[2-4], main_hypothesis, finegrained_hypothesis, key_elements[4-6], distractors[3]; raw bytes verbatim; output eval/r113_engine_bare_raw/items.jsonl + author_{id}.txt
stages.CDE_arms_scoring: tau calibration FIRST on the corpus's own pairs (positives = (key_element, own GT), negatives = (key_element, other GTs + own main); tau = midpoint(max neg, min pos) on the DISTANCE scale); bare arm = served material + minimal directive, ONE agnes generation; engine arm = rp.generator_prompt over the same served material, ONE agnes generation; judge-free scoring = graded key-element recall (SPECTER2 matcher at tau), survey recall, hit@1/MRR vs authored distractors, survey-faithfulness; engine-minus-bare PAIRED bootstrap 10k resamples SEED 113 with 95% CI; output eval/r113_engine_bare_result.json

leakage_controls: the GT fields and key_elements never enter any generation prompt; the inspiration titles are the served set both arms see equally; the matcher is the deterministic SPECTER2 stack (no judge labels anywhere)
one_generation_rule: ONE generation per item per arm, ever (Art. 29(c) one-shot); the byte-skip resume (existing {tag}.txt files are never re-requested) makes interruptions resumable WITHOUT a second generation
